## Objective
- Update the existing Mosswood game so navigation is joystick-based.

## Requirements
- Build/apply the change without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the game structure and found existing free-roam movement, keyboard controls, and a four-button touch pad.

### Active
- Replace or upgrade the directional-button pad into a joystick navigation control.
- Verify navigation and capture a screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `game-loop.js` joystick input and `index.html`/`style.css` control presentation as needed.
2. Test movement, interactions, and route transitions; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game-loop.js`: Movement logic, keyboard input, existing touch-pad handlers, and game loop.
- `index.html`: Game layout and inline `.walk-pad` styling.
- `style.css`: Main responsive layout and scene presentation.
- `game.js`: Existing game state and earlier movement implementations; may contain overlapping legacy handlers.

## Important Context
- `game-loop.js` defines `movementStick`, `setMovement`, `tickWalk`, `addTouchPad`, and `tryEnterWorldRoute`.
- Both `game-loop.js` and `game.js` contain movement/touch-pad and canvas event handlers, so check for conflicting legacy behavior.
- No files have been modified yet.

## Objective
- Update the existing Mosswood game so navigation is joystick-based.

## Requirements
- Apply the change without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use a draggable analog joystick with movement speed proportional to how far it is pushed.
- Keep click-to-move and keyboard movement, and include a separate interact control.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced the four-button touch pad with a pointer-driven joystick and interact button.
- Added responsive joystick styling and updated the scene hint to mention joystick controls.
- Added joystick accessibility labels and a note about keyboard alternatives.

### Active
- Verify joystick movement, interaction, and route transitions.
- Capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Run syntax and diff checks on the latest changes.
2. Launch the game and test joystick input, interactions, and route transitions.
3. Save a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only that latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game-loop.js`: Joystick pointer handling, movement logic, interactions, and routes.
- `style.css`: Joystick appearance and responsive styling.
- `index.html`: Scene navigation hint and inline styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `game.js` contains legacy controls, but `index.html` loads `game-loop.js` as the active game loop.
- Syntax and diff checks were run before the last small edits; browser behavior and screenshot checks are still pending.

- Keep click-to-move and keyboard movement, plus a separate interact control.

- Captured and inspected the latest 1280×960 JPEG screenshot.
